Alpha 1.79.44 (Readable district streets)

  • Dark Realm buildings smoothly reveal the hero when roofs or walls block the camera, then become solid again as the hero walks clear. Roads, floors, collision and building shadows retain their original behavior.
  • District roofs now have matte mineral slate with staggered courses and consistent surface scale.
  • Ilyra shares duplicate animation calculations within each model while preserving her original appearance and equipment.
  • Retains Lanternhold's homes, strolling residents and blended gate roads, map shortcuts, gradual quest rewards, roughly 1.5-second jumps, smooth Well Rested tracking and separate test-account reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. World art and crowded-town performance work continues. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.43 (Lanternhold neighborhoods)

  • Fifteen timber homes with slate roofs, framed windows and character-sized doors replace Lanternhold's outlying tents. Residential lanes connect the homes to town.
  • Mara, Dain, Hessa and Selen are spread through the neighborhoods. They stroll, stop to rest and pause near players for conversation, with smoothly interpolated movement and walking poses.
  • The four gates gradually blend town paving into the Earth Realm's dirt trails.
  • Combat and spell visual bursts can no longer fill the delivery lane reserved for inventory receipts, quest updates and essential encounter signals.
  • Includes the previous map shortcut correction and Dark Realm district improvements. Opening the map leaves search inactive until clicked, so M can close it again.
  • World art and performance work continues; this update does not declare final visual quality, feature freeze or closed beta. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.42

  • Opening the world map keeps search inactive until selected, so pressing M again closes the map.
  • Dark Realm district courts now have timber workbenches with cups, ledgers, books, foundry tools and scored bread, alongside folded cloth standards.
  • District buildings now have pitched roofs, framed pointed windows and distinct mooring spars, archive bands, hollow foundry flues and city crowns.

Alpha 1.79.41 (Streets beyond the veil)

  • Dark Realm streets have worn, irregular paving with shallow joints and mineral surface detail.
  • The expedition camp has tensioned canvas shelters, supported ridges and tied frames. Its four elemental lanterns now have stepped stone feet, tapered shafts and protective metal cages.
  • Water, Fire and Dark Realm waystones have distinct worn crowns and stone surfaces.
  • Retains gradual quest XP, larger dungeon story rewards and the two-level limit on any single quest turn-in.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.40 (A steadier leveling journey)

  • Quest XP now follows the quest’s intended level: ordinary story chapters award about three quarters of a level’s XP, dungeon chapters award more, and a single turn-in can never advance more than two levels.
  • Added smaller investigations and hunts along the Earth, Water and Fire journeys, replacing the large XP bursts around Verdant Bastion with gradual progress toward each dungeon.
  • Unpaid oversized story rewards are corrected for existing characters. Earned levels, paid rewards, Gold, quest progress and unlocked dungeon access are preserved; earlier added chapters remain optional for returning characters.
  • Pilgrim Rest has pitched canopies, tied ropes, supported benches and more detailed travel supplies.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.39 (Prepared character geometry)

  • Supplied characters and supported outfits load exact prepared geometry in the background, reducing repeated model preparation while preserving their appearance and animation.
  • Changed outfits and unavailable preparation data retain the existing model preparation path. Prepared data remains available for cached offline sessions.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.38 (Character preparation)

  • Improved background preparation of equipped characters while preserving their model detail, material boundaries and animation data.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.37 (Forge and merchant keyboard controls)

  • Forge gems and sockets support Tab, Enter and Space with named choices, clear selection and unavailable states, visible focus and larger touch targets.
  • Forge refreshes preserve your reading position and follow the same focused item when lists reorder. Changed equipment clears old spending choices before another operation.
  • Merchant buyback shows item names, quantities and total Gold prices. Keyboard focus stays with the current item through refreshes; removed or invalid choices cannot send an outdated action.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Improved combat stability when basic attacks land during spell casts.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.36 (Earth ground and Chronicle details)

  • Earth's open ground gains short dry thatch, while planted beds show living grass. Color, roughness and shallow relief share the same surface pattern; roads, forest litter and standing vegetation keep their existing layout.
  • Chronicle investigation and hunt items have distinct drawn symbols in item views, with clear shapes on desktop and phones.
  • Content checks now verify generated catalogs and animation inventories without rewriting them during installation or validation.
  • Terrain checks cover visible rock formations and dungeon checkpoint returns on both configured terrain profiles. Raised terrain remains disabled in the public world.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • This ground-material improvement does not establish final world-art quality or whole-game performance. Earlier frame, draw and triangle limits remain unchanged. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.35 (Build and trade reviews)

  • Direct trade keeps your item and Gold draft when your partner updates their offer. Confirm becomes available after your submitted offer is acknowledged, so the offer you review matches the one you confirm.
  • Trade actions are easier to reach on phones, with larger controls, readable Gold entry and a scrollable panel above the combat controls.
  • Desktop skill unlocks and rune choices support Tab, Enter and Space. Build updates retain your focused choice and reading position while you stay in the same view.
  • Guild calendar actions stay tied to the current plan and membership. Finding a group from a calendar card opens at the activity filters.
  • The VIP venue dialog has a clearer accessible name and more readable unavailable actions.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking, separate automation-account population reporting and the complete earlier patch history through Load more notes.
